claim: Determine unrestricted XOR-AND multiplicative complexity of reduced GF(16) multiplication on 8 input bits and 4 outputs.

searches.query: GF(16) multiplicative complexity unrestricted quadratic MF 167 9 AND gates
site.tsapps.nist.gov Boyar Find multiplicative complexity quadratic two output 919080

sources.title: Boyar-Find, Multiplicative Complexity of Vector Valued Boolean Functions
sources.verified_fact: Distinguishes circuit models and reports optimal quadratic existence for one/two-output maps, with the general finite-field case posed as open in that paper.
sources.limitation: Does not prove that every actual optimal circuit is quadratic or preserve arbitrary old wires; the historical open statement is not a current novelty audit.

sources.title: MF-167 author entry: Exact quadratic multiplicative complexity of GF(2^4) multiplication and polymul_4
sources.version_or_section: Published and last reviewed September 4, 2026; Result and Attribution
sources.verified_fact: Author lists quadratic GF(16) complexity nine, unrestricted GF(16) in [8,9], and unverified priority for the stronger quadratic claim.
sources.limitation: Author statement and scope checked; the complete evidence pack and mathematical proof were not independently replayed in this refresh.

sources.title: ML-076 author entry: Multiplicative complexity bracket for GF(2^4) multiplication
sources.verified_fact: Author marks the reduced-field unrestricted [8,9] question open and describes algebraic and direct-refutation approaches.
sources.limitation: Register status is not worldwide priority proof; its polynomial-product bracket is not adopted without reconciling the nearby Morse theorem.

sources.title: Morse, Unrestricted Boolean Multiplicative Complexity of Four-Term Binary Polynomial Multiplication
sources.version_or_section: arXiv:2608.30238v1, August 31, 2026; Abstract, theorem 9.1, formalization section
sources.verified_fact: Author states unrestricted complexity nine for the eight-input, seven-output unreduced polynomial product.
sources.limitation: Different map from reduced four-output GF(16); lower bound does not automatically transfer after output reduction. Linked Lean source/build and axiom audit were not executed here.

inaccessible_sources.title: Mirwald-Schnorr, The multiplicative complexity of quadratic boolean forms (1992)
inaccessible_sources.observed_access: Full publisher open returned HTTP 403; bibliographic and abstract search record available.
inaccessible_sources.limitation: Original full proof not inspected in this refresh.

decision.rationale: Finish final per-case auditing of existing completed scans before new expensive work, then review remaining raw-rank-six/seven cases. Sources distinguish the exact reduced-field question from known restricted or unreduced results; they do not establish novelty or solve our remaining cases.
